function.name: SLACK_CHAT_POST_MESSAGE
function.description: Deprecated: posts a message to a slack channel, direct message, or private channel. use `send message` instead.

as_user.description: Post as the authenticated user instead of as a bot. Defaults to `false`. If `true`, `username`, `icon_emoji`, and `icon_url` are ignored. If `false`, the message is posted as a bot, allowing appearance customization. Please provide a value of type boolean.
as_user.title: As User

attachments.description: URL-encoded JSON array of message attachments, a legacy method for rich content. See Slack API documentation for structure. Please provide a value of type string.
attachments.title: Attachments

blocks.description: DEPRECATED: Use `markdown_text` field instead. URL-encoded JSON array of layout blocks for rich/interactive messages. See Slack API Block Kit docs for structure. Please provide a value of type string.
blocks.title: Blocks

channel.description: ID or name of the channel, private group, or IM channel to send the message to. Please provide a value of type string. This parameter is required.
channel.title: Channel

icon_emoji.description: Emoji for bot's icon (e.g., ':robot_face:'). Overrides `icon_url`. Applies if `as_user` is `false`. Please provide a value of type string.
icon_emoji.title: Icon Emoji

icon_url.description: Image URL for bot's icon (must be HTTPS). Applies if `as_user` is `false`. Please provide a value of type string.
icon_url.title: Icon Url

link_names.description: Automatically hyperlink channel names (e.g., #channel) and usernames (e.g., @user) in message text. Defaults to `false` for bot messages. Please provide a value of type boolean.
link_names.title: Link Names

markdown_text.description: PREFERRED: Write your message in markdown for nicely formatted display. Supports: headers (# ## ###), bold (**text** or __text__), italic (*text* or _text_), strikethrough (~~text~~), inline code (`code`), code blocks (```), links ([text](url)), block quotes (>), lists (- item, 1. item), dividers (--- or ***), context blocks (:::context with images), and section buttons (:::section-button). IMPORTANT: Use \n for line breaks (e.g., 'Line 1\nLine 2'), not actual newlines. USER MENTIONS: To tag users, use their user ID with <@USER_ID> format (e.g., <@U1234567890>), not username. . Please provide a value of type string.
examples:
# Status Update

System is **running smoothly** with *excellent* performance.

```bash
kubectl get pods
```

> All services operational ✅

mrkdwn.title: Mrkdwn

parse.description: Message text parsing behavior. Default `none` (no special parsing). `full` parses as user-typed (links @mentions, #channels). See Slack API docs for details. Please provide a value of type string.
parse.title: Parse

reply_broadcast.description: If `true` for a threaded reply, also posts to main channel. Defaults to `false`. Please provide a value of type boolean.
reply_broadcast.title: Reply Broadcast

text.description: DEPRECATED: This sends raw text only, use markdown_text field. Primary textual content. Recommended fallback if using `blocks` or `attachments`. Supports mrkdwn unless `mrkdwn` is `false`. Please provide a value of type string.
examples: Reminder: Team meeting at 3 PM today.
text.title: Text

thread_ts.description: Timestamp (`ts`) of an existing message to make this a threaded reply. Use `ts` of the parent message, not another reply. Example: '1476746824.000004'. Please provide a value of type string.
thread_ts.title: Thread Ts

unfurl_links.description: Enable unfurling of text-based URLs. Defaults `false` for bots, `true` if `as_user` is `true`. Please provide a value of type boolean.
unfurl_links.title: Unfurl Links

unfurl_media.description: Disable unfurling of media content from URLs if `false`. Defaults to `true`. Please provide a value of type boolean.
unfurl_media.title: Unfurl Media

username.description: Bot's name in Slack (max 80 chars). Applies if `as_user` is `false`. Please provide a value of type string.
username.title: Username

function.name: SLACK_OPEN_DM
function.description: Opens or resumes a slack direct message (dm) or multi-person direct message (mpim) by providing either user ids or an existing channel id.

channel.description: ID or name of an existing DM or MPIM channel to open/resume. Do not use if `users` is provided. Please provide a value of type string.
channel.title: Channel

return_im.description: If `true`, returns the full DM channel object. Applies only when opening a DM via a single user ID in `users` (not with `channel`). Please provide a value of type boolean.
return_im.title: Return Im

users.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs (1 for a DM, or 2-8 for an MPIM) to open/resume a conversation. Order is preserved for MPIMs. Do not use if `channel` is provided. Please provide a value of type string.
users.title: Users

function.name: SLACK_OPEN_OR_RESUME_DIRECT_OR_MULTI_PERSON_MESSAGES
function.description: Deprecated: opens or resumes a slack direct message (dm) or multi-person direct message (mpim). use `open dm` instead.

channel.description: ID or name of an existing DM or MPIM channel to open/resume. Do not use if `users` is provided. Please provide a value of type string.
channel.title: Channel

return_im.description: If `true`, returns the full DM channel object. Applies only when opening a DM via a single user ID in `users` (not with `channel`). Please provide a value of type boolean.
return_im.title: Return Im

users.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs (1 for a DM, or 2-8 for an MPIM) to open/resume a conversation. Order is preserved for MPIMs. Do not use if `channel` is provided. Please provide a value of type string.
users.title: Users

function.name: SLACK_FIND_CHANNELS
function.description: Find channels in a slack workspace by any criteria - name, topic, purpose, or description.

parameters.description: Request schema for finding Slack channels by any criteria (name, topic, purpose, etc.).

exact_match.description: Use exact matching instead of partial matching. Defaults to false. Please provide a value of type boolean.
exact_match.title: Exact Match

exclude_archived.description: Exclude archived channels from search results. Defaults to true. Please provide a value of type boolean.
exclude_archived.title: Exclude Archived

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return (1 to 200). Defaults to 50. Please provide a value of type integer.
limit.title: Limit

member_only.description: Only return channels the user is a member of. Defaults to false. Please provide a value of type boolean.
member_only.title: Member Only

search_query.description: Search query to find channels. Searches across channel name, topic, purpose, and description (case-insensitive partial matching). Please provide a value of type string. This parameter is required.
search_query.title: Search Query

types.description: Comma-separated list of channel types to include: `public_channel`, `private_channel`, `mpim` (multi-person direct message), `im` (direct message). Defaults to public and private channels. Please provide a value of type string.
types.title: Types

parameters.title: FindChannelsRequest

function.name: SLACK_FIND_USERS
function.description: Find users in a slack workspace by any criteria - email, name, display name, or other text. includes optimized email lookup for exact email matches.

parameters.description: Request schema for finding Slack users by any criteria (email, name, etc.).

exact_match.description: Use exact matching instead of partial matching. Defaults to false. Please provide a value of type boolean.
exact_match.title: Exact Match

include_bots.description: Include bot users in search results. Defaults to false. Please provide a value of type boolean.
include_bots.title: Include Bots

include_deleted.description: Include deleted/deactivated users in search results. Defaults to false. Please provide a value of type boolean.
include_deleted.title: Include Deleted

include_restricted.description: Include restricted (guest) users in search results. Defaults to true. Please provide a value of type boolean.
include_restricted.title: Include Restricted

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return (1 to 200). Defaults to 50. Please provide a value of type integer.
limit.title: Limit

search_query.description: Search query to find users. Searches across name, display name, real name, email address, first name, last name, and status text (case-insensitive partial matching). For exact email matches with exact_match=true, uses Slack's efficient email lookup endpoint. Please provide a value of type string. This parameter is required.
search_query.title: Search Query

parameters.title: FindUsersRequest
